item.title: Keeping inflation low and stable in an uncertain world

rating.summary: Governor Macklem's speech focuses on the renewal of the Bank of Canada's monetary policy framework, confirming the 2% inflation target will remain the anchor through 2031. He discusses the challenges posed by more frequent supply shocks and the importance of a credible inflation target in uncertain times. The speech is largely institutional and forward-looking in nature, without signaling any near-term shift in the policy rate stance.
rating.stance_rationale: The speech is centered on framework renewal and communication of the 2% target rather than signaling easing or tightening; it is balanced, emphasizing both the risks of reacting too quickly and too slowly to price pressures.
key_quotes: Reacting too strongly to a temporary jump in prices can hurt the economy. Reacting too slowly to a persistent increase in prices can allow inflation to spread across many goods and services.
And in uncertain waters, it's more important than ever to have a trusted anchor.
